content: Business News Markets Vlcc Health Care Limited Vlcc Health Care Limited Vlcc Health Care Limited is a Non-govt company, incorporated on 23 Oct, 1996. It's a public unlisted company and is classified as'company limited by shares'. Company's authorized capital stands at Rs 5000.0 lakhs and has 75.340004% paid-up capital which is Rs 3767.0 lakhs. Vlcc Health Care Limited last annual general meet (AGM) happened on 28 Oct, 2017. The company last updated its financials on 31 Mar, 2017 as per Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA). Vlcc Health Care Limited is majorly in Business Services business from last 30 years and currently, company operations are active.
